title: Privacy Policy | AJNETWORKS
description: Review the AJNETWORKS Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data across our enterprise technology consulting and engineering services.
bodyHtml:
Home / Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

How AJNETWORKS collects, processes, and safeguards personal and enterprise data in accordance with the Kenya Data Protection Act (2019), Rwanda Law No. 058/2021, and GDPR.

Effective Date: August 16, 2026 | Last Updated: October 30, 2026

// 01. data controller & scope

1. Overview & Regulatory Alignment

AJNETWORKS ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy and security of personal data entrusted to us by clients, prospective partners, and website visitors across Kenya, Rwanda, East Africa, and globally. We process personal data in strict compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019, Rwanda Law No. 058/2021 Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy, and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

// 02. information we collect

2. Categories of Personal Data

We collect only the minimum data necessary to deliver our technology advisory and engineering services:

  • Consultation & Inquiry Data: Name, organization name, email address, phone number, operating region, and project description when you submit our strategy call form.
  • Telemetry & Consent-Gated Analytics: Anonymized interaction signals collected via Google Analytics 4 (GA4) strictly governed by Google Consent Mode v2 (defaulting to denied until explicit opt-in consent is granted via our privacy banner).
  • Security & Rate-Limiting Logs: Ephemeral IP metadata processed solely to prevent automated spam and abuse on our API endpoints.
// 03. purpose & legal basis

3. How We Use Your Data

We process personal information to respond to consultation requests, scope technical engagements, fulfill contractual obligations, maintain infrastructure security, and comply with statutory legal obligations. We never sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties.

// 04. security & retention

4. Data Security & Retention

All data transmissions are encrypted in transit via TLS 1.3 and guarded by HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) and Content Security Policy (CSP) controls. Inquiry records are retained only for the duration required to service the business relationship or satisfy statutory record-keeping requirements.

5. Your Data Subject Rights & Contact

You have the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, or data portability at any time. To exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer at hello@ajnetworks.co.
